subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The need for an append primitive is well-supported, but the permanent tool contract is a maintainer-owned API/product decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving extension and land once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Ask the PR to switch to a `mode` field or dedicated append tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a narrower successor
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if another branch proves the same behavior with stronger proof and a safer review surface.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving extension and land once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the agent runtime/tool API boundary and related product-surface decisions.
